indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets spirit scaling 0.005->0.006% nudges his burn, a core item.
Fortitude regen 2->2.25% max HP helps his near-universal bruiser slot.
Gun-carry archetype up but late-scaler archetype down — roughly a wash.
heroes.one_liner: Same balanced burn carry; item buffs don't fix the tempo meta outpacing his scaling.

indirect_reasons: Hollow Point resist-shred 9->10% buffs his core T2 gun slot.
Gun-carry archetype up from the dash/no-pause gun-cycle change.
Tunnel breakables delayed 3m->5m slow his early solo farm.
heroes.one_liner: Early-gun shred buff lands, but delayed tunnel farm and tempo divers still cap him.

indirect_reasons: Hollow Point resist-shred buff hits her core first-gun slot.
Tempo economy (comeback souls cut) suits her early-lead playstyle.
Poke/siege archetype down via air-drag slows, a soft offset.
heroes.one_liner: Tempo patch keeps Vindicta in A; the shred buff makes her lane pick stronger.

direct_reasons: Life Drain T3 spirit scaling +0.3->+0.45 boosts her ult heal/drain.
Essence Bomb T3 damage +26%->30% raises her burst.
Decay DPS down/duration up suits her sustained-brawl anti-heal slot.
indirect_reasons: Spirit-carry archetype down from removed comeback/Rift levers.
heroes.one_liner: Direct buffs on an already-rising pick; she stays a top spirit bruiser.

direct_reasons: Infernal Resilience T3 heal +8%->+9% is a small sustain bump.
Seismic Impact T3 Unstoppable 6s->5s is a real ult-window nerf.
indirect_reasons: Dash/melee no longer pausing gun cycle lets him weave shots between punches.
Fortitude and Decay both buffed, his core brawler items.
heroes.one_liner: Tiny numbers up, gun-cycle smoothing helps, but anti-heal meta keeps him B.

direct_reasons: Card Trick heart heal 75->60 and its spirit scaling 0.75->0.5 cut her sustain.
Card Trick Diamond resist-shred -8%->-7% (and T3 -5%->-4%) weakens her debuff.
Full Auto spirit damage per bullet 0.03->0.045 is a small compensation.
indirect_reasons: Plated Armor now blocks Full Auto's on-hit spirit damage — a direct counter.
Slowing Hex cooldown 27->29s trims her CC-build uptime.
Late-scaler archetype down with comeback souls removed.
build_changes: De-prioritize Card Trick maxing; lean Full Auto gun build over CC build.
heroes.one_liner: Card Trick gutted plus Plated Armor counter; Wraith slides out of B.
Untouched; still a coin-flip controller weak into mobile tempo comps.

direct_reasons: Kinetic Carbine min damage multiplier 25%->10% cuts her quick-scope poke.
Carbine min multiplier no longer increased by T3, removing a poke-scaling path.
indirect_reasons: Slowing Hex cooldown 27->29s trims her pick-engage frequency.
Global slow -20% reduces lockdown, offset by new anti-air on Slowing Hex.
build_changes: Lean on Echo Shard bomb over Carbine poke.
heroes.one_liner: Carbine poke trimmed; still a strong bomb-pick initiator, just less oppressive.

indirect_reasons: Diviner's Kevlar now grants +10% ultimate CDR, a core item for his ult build.
Tempo meta converts won lanes into picks, his win condition.
build_changes: Diviner's Kevlar is now a stronger buy for faster ult cycles.
heroes.one_liner: Ult-initiator gets a Kevlar CDR bump on top of a meta that loves his picks.

direct_reasons: Frozen Shelter regen now scales with spirit (0.2), a real utility buff.
Radiant Regeneration scaling 2->1.7 per boon trims his heal item.
indirect_reasons: Healer archetype neutral; tempo shift gives his cheap heals more early relevance.
heroes.one_liner: Dome buff offsets a heal-item trim; Kelvin holds his rising B slot.

direct_reasons: Fixation headshot stacks +2->+3 raises her stacking damage.
Fixation T3 weapon scaling 0.0003->0.00035 adds late gun scaling.
indirect_reasons: Gun-carry archetype up from the gun-cycle/reload changes.
Plated Armor's on-hit fix is a soft counter to her on-hit builds.
build_changes: Gun Haze with Fixation maxing is clearly the build over Echo Shard sleep.
heroes.one_liner: Fixation buffs make gun Haze the play in a tempo meta she likes.

direct_reasons: Health per boon 41->43 adds lane durability.
Crackshot T2 now applies -6% bullet resist for 5s, real pick damage.
Bounce Pad lasso extension +1s->+1.25s improves her catch.
indirect_reasons: Veil Walker nerf removes a core enabler (Sprint Boots component lost).
Tempo economy rewards her post-20 pick play.
build_changes: Consider a gun-hybrid Crackshot build; Veil Walker is now a worse slot.
heroes.one_liner: Direct buffs and tempo favor her, but the Veil Walker strip bites.
Untouched hook initiator; fine in tempo, lacks the new top-tier snowball tools.

indirect_reasons: Tunnel breakables spawn/respawn 3m->5m delays her early underground farm.
Mobile-assassin archetype up but her power is early-farm dependent.
heroes.one_liner: Breakable timing pushes back her early farm; a quiet nerf to a ~50% skirmisher.

indirect_reasons: Hollow Point shred buff helps his core slot.
Poke/siege archetype down via new air-drag slows on flyers/airborne poke.
47.7% WR pre-patch with no compensation.
heroes.one_liner: Item buff can't fix a C-tier poke carry the tempo meta punishes.

indirect_reasons: Fortitude regen buff and Decay duration buff hit his core frontline items.
Tank/frontline and early-brawl archetype favored by the tempo shift.
heroes.one_liner: Quietly winning tank gets small item help in a meta that rewards minute-one brawls.

direct_reasons: Alt fire base damage +4% and per-boon +0.2->+0.24 boost his sustained shred.
Serrated Knives at full rage now deals 3.5% current HP on impact instead of ricocheting.
indirect_reasons: Tankbuster current-HP 8%->7.5% is a small trim to his anti-tank slot.
Fortitude regen buff helps his bruiser builds.
heroes.one_liner: Current-HP knives plus alt-fire buffs keep Shiv shredding the HP pools the patch inflates.

direct_reasons: Stone Form radius 6m->5.75m and T1 heal 7%->6% trim her survivability tool.
indirect_reasons: Support archetype neutral; no item economy lever against her.
heroes.one_liner: Small Stone Form nerf won't move the support queen off the top slot.

direct_reasons: Bullet damage per boon 0.28->0.25 and fire-rate spirit scaling 0.25->0.21 cut his carry damage.
Alchemical Flask range and speed reduced 30%, gutting his catch/farm.
Willpower T3 spirit scaling +2.7->+2.1 and debuff resist 40%->30% nerf his kit.
indirect_reasons: Mercurial Magnum scaling 0.49->0.38 and Spiritual Overflow triple-nerf remove his proc build.
Veil Walker stripped (lost Sprint Boots) removes his escape enabler.
Plated Armor now blocks Mercurial on-hit spirit damage, a hard counter.
Late-scaler archetype down with comeback souls removed.
build_changes: Proc/on-hit Warden (Mercurial + Spiritual Overflow) is dead; pivot to pure silence-cage utility or drop.
heroes.one_liner: Warden's carry build deleted on all sides — a four-item pile-on; cage only.

direct_reasons: Crimson Slash T3 now adds +0.4 heal spirit scaling.
Flying Slash light-melee scaling 1.0->1.2 raises her burst.
indirect_reasons: Tankbuster 8%->7.5% is a small trim on her anti-tank slot.
Mobile-assassin and tempo archetypes up.
heroes.one_liner: More buffs atop an S-tier pick; expect her pick rate to climb further.

direct_reasons: Ground Strike T3 spirit +0.03->+0.04 and per-meter 110%->120% boost stomp Lash.
Gun falloff 18-54m->16-48m and Grapple T2 buff duration 10s->6s nerf his gun build.
Flog heal 50%->40% and T3 heal +20%->+15% cut his sustain.
indirect_reasons: Mobile-assassin archetype up in the tempo shift.
build_changes: Move off gun Lash; build stomp (Ground Strike) as the creator already suggests.
heroes.one_liner: Rebalanced into stomp Lash; still S on pick rate and mobility.

direct_reasons: The Cube cast range 26m->20m badly weakens his signature rescue.
Puddle Punch cooldown 21s->24s cuts his dueling frequency.
Alt fire damage growth -10% and Splatter T1 +2m->+1.5m trim his damage.
Splatter detonation cooldown 0.15->0.12 and Goo Ball T3 +0.2 spirit scaling are partial offsets.
indirect_reasons: Tank/enabler archetype roughly neutral in the tempo shift.
heroes.one_liner: Cube range and Puddle Punch nerfs hit his identity; only the ball buff helps.

indirect_reasons: Spirit-carry and burst-caster archetypes down/neutral in the tempo shift.
Fortitude regen buff is his only item-side help; 45.8% WR pre-patch.
heroes.one_liner: Cloak assassin still wants long fights the tempo meta doesn't allow.

indirect_reasons: Split-pusher archetype roughly neutral (objective bounties up, nearby share down).
Gun-carry archetype up, a mild tailwind.
43.4% WR pre-patch with no compensation.
heroes.one_liner: Meta still punishes slow TP split-push; no lever moved for him.

direct_reasons: Slither T3 barrier duration 5s->4s trims her defensive window.

indirect_reasons: Hollow Point shred buff helps her core gun slot.
Gun-carry archetype up; still coin-flip on enemy CC.
heroes.one_liner: Two small nerfs, one item buff; still the top-WR coin-flip carry.
Untouched steal-caster; still draft-dependent and unrankable without drafting.

indirect_reasons: Mobile-assassin archetype up, but she has no kit change to convert it.
45.2% WR on 41.6% pick rate pre-patch, falling.
heroes.one_liner: No changes given to a falling assassin; still needs a rework.

indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets scaling buff and Decay duration buff hit his core anti-heal items.
Fortitude regen buff helps his melee-bruiser brawls.
Melee/bruiser archetype favored by the tempo shift.
heroes.one_liner: Blind-pickable bruiser gets item tailwinds in a brawl-friendly patch.

Weakening Headshot shred -13%->-12% trims his core item slightly.
indirect_reasons: Hollow Point shred buff helps his first-gun slot.
Tempo meta and his 44.7% WR still work against his 'no weak point' read.

heroes.one_liner: Ult gains ricochet and split shot, but the data still says he doesn't convert.
Untouched benchmark tank; neither helped nor hurt by the tempo patch.

direct_reasons: Heavy Melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45 is a large damage buff.

Rallying Charge collision fix removes clunk.
indirect_reasons: Restorative Locket heal/boon 0.5->0.45 and range 35->32m trims her sustain item.
Slowing Hex cd 27->29s is a small tax, offset by new anti-air slow on flyers.
Lane-bully/support archetypes up; tempo meta rewards her lane win.

heroes.one_liner: Buff-stacked lane-winning support; still the patch's clearest S-tier winner.
No changes; still a utility kit high-rank players stopped trusting.

indirect_reasons: Lifestrike melee heal 100+1.5->120+1.75 and 30%->35% is effectively a Billy buff.
Lifestrike's 48% slow now drags flyers out of the air, new anti-air CC.
Decay duration buff and Fortitude regen buff hit his frontline items.
build_changes: Lifestrike now doubles as anti-air lockdown; value it over pure healing slots.
heroes.one_liner: Lifestrike buff + new anti-air slow feed an already-dominant frontline.

direct_reasons: Health per boon 33->35 adds early durability.
indirect_reasons: Toxic Bullets scaling buff and Fortitude regen buff help her item path.
Gun-carry archetype up, but her 56.7% snapshot WR is a lagging pre-patch read.
heroes.one_liner: Small health/boon plus item buffs, but her awful base stats still cap her.

indirect_reasons: Restorative Locket heal/boon 0.5->0.45 and range 35->32m nerfs his sustain item.

Initiator/lane-bully archetypes up in the tempo shift.
heroes.one_liner: Absent from notes but the archetype winner; only his Locket slot takes a trim.

direct_reasons: Only a bug fix (helper follow) and a Lil Helpers target UI change — no power move.
heroes.one_liner: Pure quality-of-life patch for Rem; strength unchanged.

direct_reasons: Health per boon 28->31 and sprint speed 1.5->2.5 are big stat buffs.

Dashes/light melee no longer pause gun cycle, directly boosting her high-cycle gun.
Boot Kick and Entangling Bola now only target heroes/objectives, removing wasted hits.
indirect_reasons: Hollow Point shred buff and Fortitude regen buff hit her core slots.
Diviner's Kevlar +10% ult CDR helps her existing buy.
Gun-carry and tank archetypes both up.
build_changes: Weighted Bola is now a core grounded-interrupt pick; build around gun-tank with Diviner's Kevlar.
heroes.one_liner: The patch's biggest winner headlined by a Phantom-Strike-style grounded Bola.

direct_reasons: Stamina cooldown 5->5.3, Light Eater spirit lifesteal 20%->18%, Dazzling Trick cd 34s->38s.
Shining Wonder radius 16.5m->15.5m, T3 bounces +8->+6, Radiant Daggers T2 +80->+70, Light Eater T3 +25->+22.
indirect_reasons: Slows now affect air drag by 35%, punishing her flying kit.
Spirit-carry archetype down with comeback/Rift levers removed.
Paige's rise and the anti-scaling tilt squeeze her slot.
